```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Ingest data

```{r cars}
header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
df_kc <- read_tsv("~/qb26-answers/week1/hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )

ggplot(df_kc, aes(x=start,stop, y=count)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(chr~.,ncol=5, scales = "free_x") +
  ggsave("~/qb26-answers/week1/exercise_1.png")

```
